Hello again! I would like to commission a Pokemon battle collab with my OC with the green hair Cedric and my friend’s OC the brown hair Nagashiro. 

Nagashiro has his trainer outfit and uses Chien Pao

Cedric wears the same outfit as the backpacker trainers with his headband and uses Raikou

The pose is shown in the reference link, thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/5Qyx5lf

https://imgur.com/a/5Qyx5lf

Hello again, I hope you're doing well! The birthday of my OC Selia is approaching so I would like to make a request! I would like you to draw Selia as a child and adult in the pose of the Sonic Generations title screen; you can draw them behind a ring too! I would like 'Selia Generations' to be written in front of the ring and you can replace the SEGA logo with my name! Sorry for the long request, but I hope you accept!

https://imgur.com/a/gpwaWGL

Hello! I would like to commission an artwork of two OCs being Skadi and Vivianne. They both are in the pose of Sonic and Shadow from Sonic Adventures 2 with Skadi posing as Sonic and Vivi posing as Shadow. How you wish to draw them and the background is all up to you, thank you :)

https://imgur.com/a/C2W33bJ
I would like to have a creative character, Rico, please.

Hello, nice to meet you! I would like to request my OC Selia, she is a 10 year old girl! Can you draw her doing Sonic's signature pose from the Sonic Adventure game please?

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1X2Zp5Tvj4o2uzyy6MLNUVOSddJZx7IXq/view?usp=drivesdk

I am the one who received your appeal. I apologize for the delay in responding.
As soon as possible, I would like to request illustrations for my own novel, "The Backyard Was the Back Dungeon" (https://estar.jp/novels/25085088).

The reference image will be pasted to the document URL.

I would like to give you a brief description of the character's setting.

She is a demon girl (like a demon king in other works) and is the last boss in the story so far.

The composition, background, and situation are all up to you.

The finished work will be used as illustrations for various novel submission sites.

Thank you in advance.

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/99827103

Hello, please draw my OC, Eraphie Eclipse. She's a wizard attending magic university while doing a part-time magical girl job. Eraphie is energetic and has a nerdy side.
I have provided reference: https://imgur.com/a/Nmy1nHr. Please draw her in "Outfit B". It is a magical outfit given to Eraphie by the mystical moon rabbit people. Eraphie is excited to do magical girl missions around the city with the outfit on!

https://imgur.com/a/Nmy1nHr

Please allow me to request Fate from Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha.

I would like her in her 1st barrier jacket, without waist belt, skirt and cape.

If possible, please pose her in a pose that does not hide the bottom of her leotard.

Hello! I absolutely love the previous work you did for me! So I thought of requesting again if you don't mind... Can you draw my OCs, Kris and Ellie? They are both close friends. You can draw them however you like! I'm sorry if this is too much🙏

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jaEz_lad3PuBGG61OWX81LaeETIz7zyy/view?usp=drivesdk

Good afternoon and thanks for the appeal. 
Here's the link with visual references.

I will leave the details up to you.

Nice to meet you. My name is Itakage Kuon, and I am an individual Vtuber.
I saw a very nice illustration!
I would like to request you to draw me (Itakage Kwon).
Here is the outline. Thank you very much for your consideration.

Outline
I would like an illustration of me in my normal costume.
I would like to leave all the poses, compositions and backgrounds to you.

We currently do not have a three-sided view of the design.
I would appreciate it if you could refer to the standing drawings and illustrations on Twitter.
https://twitter.com/ItakageKuon

Please refer to the profile at the end of this document to get an idea of the background and poses, if necessary.

Delivery Format
Please use PSD as the file format.
We may use only portraits, so we would appreciate it if you could separate the layers for the background, portraits, and signatures.

Usage
For use on youtube and various social networking sites.

We would appreciate your consideration.

Profile
I am Itakage Kuon, a general otaku type virtual lifer.
I'm going to spread otaku culture to the world with my comrades through the virtual world.
I'm going to have a lot of fun with my comrades.
Usually I deliver: chatting, games, planning
